<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a [[cooking]] resource used in various [[Fishing|fish]]-related recipes. It can either be crafted at the cooking table or purchased from the [[Lighthouse Keeper]]. Recipes in the [[cooking table]] are only revealed after you've caught the prerequisite fish at least once.
